title: From chip to animal: chip drug knobs on a whole fly brain (SIMULATED)
status: registered before the drug sweep, the evoked-pulse runs and the replication runs were made
seen_before_registration: sugar -> MN9 on FlyWire 783 with this code, 10 trials, seeds 0-9: 80.7 Hz; with bitter 4.6 Hz
sugar -> MN9 on FlyWire 630 with the published code, 4 trials: 77.25 Hz
two 10 s spontaneous runs (seed 1, background 5 mV): inhibition x1.0 and GABA+glutamate x0.5; 3-unit electrodes; mfr 58 -> 133 Hz per electrode, synchrony 0.36 -> 0.66
spontaneous whole-region cross-correlation vs connectome asymmetry on those runs: Spearman 0.15, sign agreement 0.53 (x1.0); -0.01, 0.50 (x0.5)
continuous (not pulsed) region stimulation, seed 0, 1 s, 62 regions: whole-region Spearman 0.22, sign agreement 0.58, strong pairs 0.64

design.model: Shiu et al. 2024 LIF, FlyWire 783, constants unchanged
design.disruption_index: mean over MN9|sugar, MN9|sugar+bitter, aBN1|JO-CE and descending neurons recruited (>=10 Hz)|sugar of |log2((x + 1) / (x_vehicle + 1))|

R1_replication.statement: Sugar -> MN9 on 783 (this code) is within 20% of 630 (this code), same seeds

B1_disinhibition_releases_feeding_from_b.statement: Blocking GABA erodes bitter gating of MN9: MN9|sugar+bitter rises with dose
B1_disinhibition_releases_feeding_from_b.test: Spearman(block fraction, MN9|sugar+bitter) over vehicle + 5 gaba_block levels >= 0.8

B2_excitation_block_silences_motor_outpu.statement: ACh block lowers MN9|sugar and aBN1|JO-CE monotonically
B2_excitation_block_silences_motor_outpu.test: Spearman(block fraction, readout) <= -0.8 for both readouts over vehicle + 4 ach_block levels

B3_disinhibition_recruits_off_target_des.statement: Under sugar drive, more descending neurons fire as GABA is blocked

C1_chip_tracks_disruption.statement: Across the 21 drug conditions, the chip's firing-rate change tracks behavioural disruption

C2_chip_is_the_earlier_sentinel.statement: For every mechanism, the chip detects at a dose no higher than the one that impairs behaviour
C2_chip_is_the_earlier_sentinel.test: for each condition family with any impairment: first level with |delta log2 mfr| >= 0.5 comes at or before the first level with disruption >= 0.5

A1_direction_agreement_with_real_chips.statement: The fly array reproduces real-chip directions at least as often as the chip twin does (HD13), over the four matched mechanisms
A1_direction_agreement_with_real_chips.test: sum of fly agreeing features >= sum of twin agreeing features, scored on the same established real features

D1_spontaneous_direction_is_near_chance.statement: Confirmation on fresh seeds: spontaneous cross-correlation does not recover region-to-region direction
D1_spontaneous_direction_is_near_chance.test: whole-region sign agreement on strongly asymmetric pairs < 0.65

D2_pulsed_stimulation_recovers_direction.statement: Pulsed stimulation with an early response window recovers direction where spontaneous activity does not
D2_pulsed_stimulation_recovers_direction.test: whole-region sign agreement on strongly asymmetric pairs >= 0.70 and exceeds the spontaneous value by >= 0.10

D3_an_electrode_array_sees_it_too.statement: The same holds when only the virtual array's single units are read
D3_an_electrode_array_sees_it_too.test: array sign agreement on strongly asymmetric pairs >= 0.65

reporting: Every prediction is reported with its value and pass/fail, whichever way it falls. Analyses not listed here are labelled exploratory.
